technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals present but lack confirmation from price action, moving averages, and volume; long-term trend structure intact but short-term momentum remains bearish.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk 56 days out.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: low — small amounts, mixed party, stale trades
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and aged (83+ days old) with no conviction signal; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (395.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 56 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Stochastic bullish cross and StochRSI cross-up in extreme fear (22/100) present classic oversold bounce setup with 50/200 EMA bullish alignment intact.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below all major moving averages with zero volume confirmation, negative MACD histogram, and crisis-level VIX (395.2) in unfavourable macro environment—bounce signals lack structural support.

decision.entry_rationale: Stochastic bullish cross and StochRSI cross-up in extreme fear present oversold bounce setup, but price remains structurally below all major moving averages with zero volume confirmation, negative MACD histogram, and crisis VIX (395.2) dominating risk.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (395.2) and unfavourable macro environment override technical bounce signals; price lacks structural support below all major MAs; earnings event risk in 56 days adds event uncertainty.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical bounce signals lack confirmation; fundamental and sentiment offer only weak contrarian support insufficient to overcome macro and structural risks
